name: Quadrille tailscale
author: jwric
description: Tailscale status, connections, exit nodes and machines on the pixel grid: a switch in the head, the connection and exit node in use an inverse block, brackets for the keyboard cursor, a 7 x 7 sprite for each machine's system.
